contests.title: Van Buren County Community School District — Measure US: School revenue and refinancing bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Van Buren County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Van Buren County Community School District in the Counties of Van Buren, Davis, Henry and Lee, State of Iowa, be authorized to issue approximately $13,800,000 School Infrastructure Sales, Services and Use Tax Revenue and Refunding Bonds, which may be issued in one or more series over multiple fiscal years pursuant to Iowa Code Section 423F.2 and 423E.5, in the approximate amount of $13,800,000 for the purpose of providing funds to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the Keosauqua campus, including a secure entrance, classrooms, commons, and office space, and to improve the site; and to currently refund the outstanding School Infrastructure Sales, Services and Use Tax Revenue Bonds, Series 2022A, dated July 15, 2022, including costs of issuance and a debt service reserve fund if required by the purchaser; with any bond proceeds remaining after completion of this project used for other school infrastructure projects as authorized by the School District's Revenue Purpose Statement?

measures.questionText: Shall the Board of Directors of the Van Buren County Community School District in the Counties of Van Buren, Davis, Henry and Lee, State of Iowa, be authorized to issue approximately $13,800,000 School Infrastructure Sales, Services and Use Tax Revenue and Refunding Bonds, which may be issued in one or more series over multiple fiscal years pursuant to Iowa Code Section 423F.2 and 423E.5, in the approximate amount of $13,800,000 for the purpose of providing funds to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the Keosauqua campus, including a secure entrance, classrooms, commons, and office space, and to improve the site; and to currently refund the outstanding School Infrastructure Sales, Services and Use Tax Revenue Bonds, Series 2022A, dated July 15, 2022, including costs of issuance and a debt service reserve fund if required by the purchaser; with any bond proceeds remaining after completion of this project used for other school infrastructure projects as authorized by the School District's Revenue Purpose Statement?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes about $13.8 million in school sales, services and use-tax revenue and refinancing bonds, which may be issued in one or more batches across budget years. Funds would add classrooms, a secure entrance, common areas and offices at the Keosauqua campus and improve the site; refinance the 2022A infrastructure bonds; and cover issuance costs and a reserve if the purchaser requires one. Leftover money could fund other school infrastructure projects allowed by the district’s revenue-use plan.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the school revenue and refinancing bonds.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this bond issue.
